unit.id: dictionary attack#1

The length of the password hardly matters to the computer, as long as it is contained in the word list. There are huge lists of passwords on the internet that were captured in real data leaks. This is an important reason why you should never use the same password for different accounts.#1

segment.source: The length of the password hardly matters to the computer, as long as it is contained in the word list. There are huge lists of passwords on the internet that were captured in real data leaks. This is an important reason why you should never use the same password for different accounts.
segment.target: La lunghezza della password non ha praticamente alcuna importanza per il computer, purché sia contenuta nell’elenco di parole. Su Internet sono disponibili enormi elenchi di password che sono state acquisite in seguito a vere e proprie fughe di dati. Questo è un motivo importante per cui non si dovrebbe mai utilizzare la stessa password per account diversi.
